text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc on Wednesday said it reduced its earnings estimate for Harley-Davidson Inc in the first quarter of 1997 to $0.48 a share from $0.52, and its estimate for the full year to $2.19 from $2.24.

-- Mesirow said the estimate cuts were based on a $2.0 million contract signing bonus paid to union workers at a Harley plant in York, Pennsylvania, and a $3.0 million addition to the company's product-liability reserve after the settlement of a lawsuit earlier this month.
-- The signing bonus should be reflected in the costs of goods sold, while the liability reserve should increase selling, general and administrative expenses, Mesirow said.
-- Harley shares were off 1/4 at 37-1/4 in early afternoon trading.
